scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with reproducible finite diagnostics; all supplied review is non-independent.
scientific_limitations: Only finite products of type-I Cartan matrix balls, commuting 2x2 strict block contractions, scalar bounded holomorphic functions. Size-three failure is previously known for row balls. Not complete contractivity, a higher-level estimate, or a proof of a bounded Gleason property; residual older interpolation-priority risk.
title: Sharp level-two von Neumann inequalities on products of Cartan matrix balls
